title: Arrival and departure by public transport – BER Airport
claims: The Airport Express (FEX) runs between Berlin Hauptbahnhof, Potsdamer Platz, Südkreuz and BER Airport.
The FEX runs every 15 minutes from 4 a.m. to 1 a.m., with a journey time of about 23 minutes from Hauptbahnhof, 19 minutes from Potsdamer Platz and 14 minutes from Südkreuz.
Regional trains RE20, RB22, RB24 and RB32 also serve BER Airport.
S-Bahn lines S9 and S85 serve BER Airport every 20 minutes.
Express bus X7 runs every 5 to 10 minutes between U Rudow and BER Airport.
The BER Airport railway station is directly under Terminal 1 on level U2.
